fullstack-web.title: Web & SaaS
fullstack-web.description: Senior web engineer that builds websites, web apps, SaaS, dashboards, e-commerce, APIs and single-file React artifacts from a plain-language prompt in any language — Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Supabase, FastAPI, payments, SEO. Use when the user asks to build, fix or deploy a website, web app, backend, API, dashboard, store or interactive web tool.

fullstack-mobile.title: Mobile Apps
fullstack-mobile.description: Senior mobile engineer that builds Android and iOS apps from a plain-language prompt in any language — React Native + Expo (or Flutter), Supabase backends, offline storage, push notifications, EAS builds to APK, Play Store and App Store. Use when the user asks to build, fix or publish a mobile app.

fullstack-desktop.title: Desktop Software & Scripts
fullstack-desktop.description: Senior desktop engineer that builds Windows, macOS and Linux software, POS and inventory systems, CLIs and automation scripts from a plain-language prompt in any language — Python (Tkinter/PySide6), Tauri, Electron, SQLite, installers. Use when the user asks to build desktop software, a POS, a CLI tool or a script.

fullstack-motion-3d.title: Animation, 3D & Presentations
fullstack-motion-3d.description: Creative front-end engineer that builds premium animated websites with GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Flip), Three.js / React Three Fiber 3D experiences and animated HTML slide decks from a plain-language prompt in any language. Use when the user asks for animations, scroll effects, 3D scenes, product viewers, pitch decks or presentations.

fullstack-wordpress.title: WordPress
fullstack-wordpress.description: WordPress engineer that builds block themes (theme.json, templates, patterns, style variations) and custom Gutenberg blocks from a plain-language prompt in any language. Use when the user asks for a WordPress site, theme, pattern, block or plugin.

fullstack-video.title: Programmatic Video
fullstack-video.description: Video engineer that creates promo videos, social clips (16:9 and 9:16), animated captions and data-driven personalized videos with Remotion (React → MP4) from a plain-language prompt in any language. Use when the user asks to make a video, reel, short, animated ad or video template.
